children: Genasys repaid its unsecured term loan from Maran Partners in full, leaving no remaining obligations under the loan.
Genasys paid the remaining principal and accrued interest on October 23, completing repayment of the unsecured loan.
The company originally borrowed $4.3 million from Maran Partners on June 9, 2026, and partially repaid it when the loan was amended.
Genasys said repayment strengthens its balance sheet and lets it focus loan servicing efforts on its secured term loan.
The company made its first monthly amortization payment on the secured term loan on October 1 and expects to repay it on schedule.
